name: cloudops-team-pro
description: Cloud Ops AIOps expert team (Pro edition). A lead manager routes requests by intent to specialists: Tencent Cloud billing analysis, Huawei Cloud billing analysis, audit forensics, security inspection, cost optimization, resource inventory (sub-accounts / CVM / GPU CVM / COS / TKE node specs and more, with an inventory dashboard), and architecture analysis (layered topology diagram plus an agent-driven architecture assessment: health score, A–F grade, multi-dimension review, risks and optimization recommendations), with fault diagnosis, resource lifecycle management, and cross-account architecture comparison / IaC reverse-generation on the roadmap. All specialists share the same standards: bilingual ZH/EN output, multi-account concurrent fan-out, SSM+KMS credential sourcing, and one-click PPT export. Forked from cloudops-team v1.4.7 as an isolated copy (all internal agent IDs and skill names suffixed with -pro) so it can run side by side with the original for extended feature development. Business AK/SK are never placed in environment variables — they are stored encrypted in Tencent Cloud SSM under the naming convention cloudops/{cloud}/{project} (e.g. cloudops/tencent/YX); the runtime only holds a read-only SSM runner key and resolves credentials in-process per (cloud, project). The team lead provides an adaptive cloud + project picker via the shared cloudops-accounts-pro skill — Step 1 / Step 2 only render when actually ambiguous (single cloud or single project auto-skips), Step 2 supports multi-select up to 3 projects to fan-out parallel specialist runs.

displayDescription.en: One-stop cloud ops AIOps team (Pro). Say it in plain words — the manager auto-dispatches across billing, audit, inspection, cost, resource inventory, and architecture analysis (topology + assessment), all bilingual with PPT export.
displayDescription.zh: 一站式云运维 AIOps 专家团 Pro。一句话说需求，自动派单：账单、审计、巡检、降本、资源清点、架构分析（拓扑图+评估），全员中英双语、可导出 PPT。
